checks.name: the stream arrived
checks.why: every figure in this document is computed over these datagrams, so a run that received none makes each of them an absence rather than a number

checks.name: audio was decoded and not merely concealed
checks.why: the concealer produces plausible samples from an empty stream indefinitely, so a callback count, an underrun count of zero and a continuity figure are all consistent with a path that carried nothing; a decoded frame is not

checks.name: every sample the stream produced reached the device
checks.why: this is the criterion the phase turns on: expected counts every per-channel sample the playout cursor travelled and played counts the ones the producer deposited, with a gap concealment credited because the waveform continued across it and an underrun refused because nothing of the stream was there. The population is the expected samples, because a hole of zero over an expectation of zero is a run that carried nothing

checks.name: the device was never handed silence
checks.why: a cycle the ring could not fill is a whole IO buffer of silence sent to a device in place of audio, which is audible however small the sample count beside it looks; the population is the cycles, because no cycles means no silence for a trivial reason

checks.name: no frame arrived in time and failed to decode
checks.why: a payload the decoder refuses is a disagreement between the two ends about the format, which no amount of buffering repairs and which concealment hides completely in every other counter here

checks.name: no packet carried a timestamp off the frame grid
checks.why: a timestamp that is not a whole number of frames from the one that anchored the stream is a sender running at another frame duration, and the symptom is a run that conceals everything and plays nothing

checks.name: decode p99 under a tenth of the frame
checks.why: a tenth of the 5 ms frame is 500 us, and the producer has to decode and deposit inside its period or the device finds an empty ring; p99 rather than the mean, because a frame late once every hundred is a click a listener hears

checks.name: the left channel arrives as its own tone
checks.why: a packet count and a callback count agree just as happily when the path carries digital silence, and this project has read that agreement as success; 997 Hz comes out of the samples that were played, at a window resolution of 2 Hz

checks.name: the right channel arrives as its own tone
checks.why: the two channels carry different frequencies so that channel order is provable across the whole link rather than assumed, and a right channel reading 997 Hz is what a swap looks like

checks.name: the played channels stay distinct
checks.why: two channels reading one frequency is consistent with a fold to mono, with one channel encoded twice, and with an analysis reading its own scratch buffer, and every count in this document is consistent with all three

environment.receiver_scheduled_as: time constraint, period 5.000 ms computation 0.625 ms constraint 2.500 ms

findings: 0.000 per cent of the stream was lost over the link, 0 packets of the 24003 the sequence numbers describe

frames arrived -6.9 ms past their moment at p50, -3.7 at p95, 13.8 at p99 and 87.1 at worst, against a target of 5 ms; negative is margin in hand, and the shape is what says whether the target is short by a fixed amount every frame pays or long enough for all but a tail
the jitter buffer held 5.0 ms at p50 and 10.0 ms at p99 against a 5 ms target, measured after serving each frame

the ring sat at 2176 frames of 4096 at p50, having been primed to 496; the difference is the 32.9 ms `AudioDeviceStart` spent getting the device going, during which the producer kept depositing and the device consumed nothing, so it is the ring's contribution to latency and it belongs to the device rather than to the link
